# OeAD Student Housing

> > Austria's leading provider of student accommodation in Vienna, Innsbruck, and other university cities, offering diverse housing options from student residences to guesthouses.

OeAD Student Housing manages a comprehensive network of student accommodation facilities across Austria, with major locations including Vienna residences (Gasgasse, Kandlgasse, Molkereistrasse, Sechshauser Strasse, Simmeringer Hauptstrasse, Tigergasse, and others) and Innsbruck properties. The platform provides searchable room listings with price filters and booking capabilities for international and domestic students.

## Key Topics

- OeAD
- Student housing in Vienna
- Student housing in Innsbruck
- Gasgasse residence
- Kandlgasse residence
- Molkereistrasse residence
- Sechshauser Strasse residence
- PopUp dorms
- Room types and pricing
- Guesthouse rentals
- Student residence booking
- Apartment search and filters
- Short-term and long-term accommodation

## Vienna Accommodation

- [Vienna Student Housing Overview](https://www.oeadstudenthousing.at/en/accommodation/vienna/): Comprehensive overview of student accommodation in Vienna with room search, pricing filters, and available residences including Gasgasse, Kandlgasse, Molkereistrasse, Sechshauser Strasse, Simmeringer Hauptstrasse, Tigergasse, Auf der Schmelz, Hafnersteig, Obermuellnerstrasse, Poetzleinsdorfer Strasse, PopUp dorms, Sonnenallee, and Adelheid-Popp-Gasse

## Innsbruck Accommodation

- [Innsbruck Student Housing Overview](https://www.oeadstudenthousing.at/en/accommodation/innsbruck/): Student housing options in Innsbruck featuring various room types, pricing information, and booking procedures for university students
